decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to utilize enchantments to generate card advantage and mana acceleration while controlling the board with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing. The key strategy is to assemble a combination of Argothian Enchantress, Enchantress's Presence, and Mirri's Guile to draw cards and generate value. The deck also aims to win by using the combo of Opalescence and Parallax Wave or by stalling the game with Solitary Confinement and Worship until the opponent runs out of resources.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful threats such as Exalted Angel and Eternal Dragon. By using cards like Swords to Plowshares, Duress, Gerrard's Verdict, and Vindicate, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and keep the board clear of threats. The inclusion of Decree of Justice provides the deck with a win condition in the late game, while cards like Skeletal Scrying and Haunting Echoes help to draw cards and disrupt the opponent's deck. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and provide consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying creatures with the Madness ability to apply early pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards like Basking Rootwalla, Wild Mongrel, and Squee, Goblin Nabob, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while also utilizing Survival of the Fittest to ensure a steady stream of threats. The addition of countermagic and removal spells like Counterspell and Swords to Plowshares help to protect and support the aggressive game plan. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Wasteland and Gaea's Cradle to provide additional advantages in the game.

The deck focuses on playing low-cost aggressive white creatures and using powerful support cards like Mother of Runes, Disenchant, Swords to Plowshares, and Crusade to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By quickly establishing a board presence and using efficient removal spells, the deck aims to attack relentlessly and deal damage to the opponent before they can stabilize or mount a strong defense. The deck's strategy relies on tempo and aggression, aiming to win the game as quickly as possible by curving out with efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through countering spells, removing threats, and drawing cards efficiently. The deck aims to control the game by using various counterspells like Counterspell and Mana Leak, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, and card draw spells like Accumulated Knowledge and Fact or Fiction. It also includes utility cards like Chain of Vapor and Stifle to further disrupt the opponent's strategy, while utilizing lands like Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave as win conditions.

This deck focuses on utilizing the mana ramping abilities of Elves to quickly accelerate into powerful threats and disrupt the opponent. By utilizing cards like Llanowar Elves and Priest of Titania to generate mana, the deck can quickly drop big threats like Deranged Hermit and Masticore. The inclusion of survival of the fittest allows for tutoring key creatures to the hand, ensuring a consistent board presence and applying pressure early on. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and mana generation.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of countermagic and removal spells, while also utilizing the card advantage from Fact or Fiction to maintain control over the board. The key strategy revolves around utilizing Oath of Druids to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Terravore and Exalted Angel, overwhelming the opponent with threats while disrupting their game plan with cards like Mana Leak and Swords to Plowshares. The deck also includes land destruction cards like Wasteland and Cataclysm to disrupt the opponent's mana base and prevent them from mounting a strong offense.

The main idea of this deck is to slow down your opponent's strategy with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Wasteland, while also ramping up your own resources with cards like Mox Diamond and Sylvan Library. The key win condition revolves around using Oath of Druids to get out powerful creature Terravore and control the game with cards like Winter's Grasp and Pyroclasm. The deck aims to disrupt your opponent's game plan and take control of the game through efficient resource management and powerful creatures.

Control the game by using Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures into play and disrupt your opponent's strategy with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Cataclysm. Use card draw and recursion to ensure you have the resources you need to outlast your opponent. Land destruction and disruption help keep your opponent off balance while you build your board state. Make strategic use of your mana base to maximize your resources and capitalize on your opponent's mistakes. Be patient and wait for the right moment to strike and secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key card in this deck is Psychatog, which can quickly become a powerful threat by discarding cards to pump its power and toughness. The deck also includes card draw spells like Accumulated Knowledge and Impulse to ensure a steady stream of resources. Overall, the goal of this archetype is to outmaneuver the opponent and maintain control of the game until Psychatog can secure the victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to cast Replenish and bring back powerful enchantments like Opalescence, Parallax Wave, and Parallax Tide from the graveyard. The deck uses cards like Stifle, Swords to Plowshares, and Seal of Cleansing to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own combo pieces. With the ability to generate a powerful board presence and control the game through enchantments, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on creating a lock with Stasis, preventing opponents from untapping their permanents. It uses various control and draw spells to maintain the lock while utilizing cards like Black Vise and Forsaken City to pressure the opponent's life total. The deck aims to stall the game with Stasis in play, eventually finding a win condition like Brain Freeze or a massive Gush into Mana Short or Upheaval to disrupt the opponent's board state and secure the victory.

The main idea of this deck is to lock down opponents with the Stasis enchantment while using combo pieces like Black Vise and combos like Brain Freeze to win the game. The deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies with counterspells and bouncing spells, while also utilizing card draw and mana acceleration to keep the combo pieces flowing. The inclusion of cards like Forsaken City and Cephalid Coliseum provide additional utility and card advantage in the deck. Overall, the key concept is to create a powerful and synergistic combo deck that can control the game and win through clever manipulation of resources.

The goal of this deck is to quickly assemble the Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle combo to create a powerful threat and disrupt opponents' plans. The deck includes a suite of counterspells and draw spells to protect the combo pieces and dig for the missing parts. The use of cheap interaction and card draw allows for flexibility and adaptation to different matchups, while the land base is optimized to support the combo strategy. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently execute its game plan and control the game tempo to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Phyrexian Dreadnought combo with Stifle to deny your opponent the chance to respond. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's plans with counterspells and stifle effects, allowing you to combo off and defeat your opponent before they have a chance to react. The deck also includes cantrips and card draw spells to help find the combo pieces quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly getting out Phyrexian Dreadnought and stopping opponents from responding with counterspells and disruption. By combining Stifle and other instant spells with Dreadnought, the deck aims to create a powerful and hard-to-stop combo that can win the game in just a few turns. The deck also includes card draw and deck manipulation to help find the necessary pieces for the combo.
